meaning:
περι-βλέπω
[in LXX for שׁוּר, etc. ;]
to look around (at). Mid., to look about one (at) : absol., Mrk.9:8 10:23; with inf., Mrk.5:32; with accusative of person(s), Mrk.3:5, 34, Luk.6:10; πάντα, Mrk.11:11.†
(AS)

renderings.kjv: when he had looked round about
when they had looked round about
when he had looked round about upon

elsewhere.note: When he had looked around at them with anger, being grieved at the hardening of their hearts, he said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out…
He looked around at them all, and said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He did, and his hand was restored as sound as the other.
